sources.locator: Title search: 椭圆曲线密码

statement.zh: **术语**：椭圆曲线密码（Elliptic Curve Cryptography (ECC)）。NIST SP 800-186「Recommendations for Discrete Logarithm-based Cryptography: Elliptic Curve Domain Parameters」（2023 年 2 月）规定曲线的表示方式：「Each recommended curve is uniquely defined by its domain parameters D, which indicate the field GF(q) over which the elliptic curve is defined, the parameters of its defining equation, and principal parameters, such as the cofactor h of the curve, the order n of its prime-order subgroup, and a designated point G on the curve of order n (i.e., the "base point")」。§2.1.1 给出 Weierstrass 方程 y² = x³ + ax + b，§2.1.3 给出 twisted Edwards 形式并说明 a = 1 时即为 Edwards 曲线。
statement.en: **Term**: Elliptic Curve Cryptography (ECC).It is registered under asymmetric public-key cryptography, digital signatures.

statement.zh: 强度与基阶直接挂钩：§3.1.2 说明「The security strength of an elliptic curve is directly related to the order of the basepoint.In general, if an elliptic curve has a basepoint of order n, then the security strength will be approximately one half of the bit length of n」。表 1 据此给出对应：112 位强度用 P-224、K-233、B-233，128 位用 P-256、Curve25519、Edwards25519 等，192 位用 P-384，224 位用 Curve448/Edwards448/E448/W-448，256 位用 P-521 与 K-571/B-571。
statement.en: It is listed because it connects concrete records, objects or procedures in asymmetric public-key cryptography, digital signatures, not because of its name.

statement.zh: 该文件说明自己「intended for use in conjunction with … NIST SP 800-56A …; FIPS 186-5, Digital Signature Standard」。表 2 规定各曲线允许用途：P-224 到 P-521 与 Edwards25519/Edwards448 分别用于「ECDSA, EC key establishment」与 EdDSA，而 Curve25519、W-25519、Curve448、E448、W-448 标注「Not to be used for ECDSA or EdDSA directly」。执行摘要还说明文件承接 FIPS 186-4 中的曲线、新增两条 Edwards 曲线，并把二进制曲线标记为弃用。
statement.en: Fix the object and its aliases; list the sourced dates, roles, parameters or inscriptions; state the observable output; then test the boundary.Any step without a source stops there rather than being filled with prose.

statement.zh: 两条边界被明确写出。其一是遗留曲线：不满足 SP 800-57 Part 1 当前比特强度要求的 FIPS 186-4 曲线成为 legacy-use，「They may be used to process already protected information (e.g., decrypt or verify) but not to apply protection to information (e.g., encrypt or sign)」，P-192、K-163、B-163 即属此类。其二是域参数有效性：§3.2.1.2 的脚注说「it is essential to verify domain parameter validity to ensure that users are performing operations on P-224 and not on its quadratic twist」；附录 C.1 要求曲线与二次 twists 都满足准则，并规定 cofactor h ≤ 2^10 与避免异常曲线（|E| ≠ q）。
statement.en: The boundary separates a sourced fact, a model-derived relation and an unverified gap.Secondary summaries yield to primary material; unsourced dates, counts and device values stay blank.

statement.zh: SP 800-186 由 Chen、Moody、Randall、Regenscheid 与 Robinson 撰写，2023 年 2 月发布，NIST 编辑评审委员会于 2022 年 9 月 7 日批准。文件把 FIPS 186-4 时代的曲线清单迁移到 FIPS 186-5 的框架下（后者 §6 说明 ECDSA 是「the elliptic curve analog of DSA」并把域参数生成指向 SP 800-186），同时新增 Edwards 曲线、弃用二进制曲线。
statement.en: Registered period: Public-key Revolution, The Frontier.The exact date is left to the ledger; institutional placement and technical detail follow the cited sources.
